request.query: norm of a finite product is at most the product of the norms

items.name: Finset.norm_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖

items.name: Finset.norm_prod_le'
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] (s : Finset ι),
  s.Nonempty → ∀ (f : ι → α), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖

items.name: Finset.nnnorm_prod_le'
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] (s : Finset ι),
  s.Nonempty → ∀ (f : ι → α), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊

items.name: Complex.norm_prod
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ), ‖s.prod f‖ = ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖

items.name: Finset.nnnorm_prod_le_sup_nnnorm
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup M] [IsUltrametricDist M] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ s.sup fun x => ‖f x‖₊

items.name: IsUltrametricDist.norm_prod_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup M] [IsUltrametricDist M] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} {C : ℝ},
  0 ≤ C → (∀ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ≤ C) → ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ C

items.name: Finset.nnnorm_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊

items.name: nnnorm_prod
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedCommRing α] [NormMulClass α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset β)
  (f : β → α), ‖∏ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ = ∏ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊
